captions.detailed: This 3D model is a protective leg cage designed with a low-polygon, faceted dome shape. It features a hollow semi-cylindrical body with rounded, domed ends and a flat bottom edge for resting on a flat surface. Transverse ventilation slots are cut evenly along the upper curved surface, and a circular opening is present at one of the domed ends to accommodate a leg.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric protective leg cage for a cat's bandaged leg. The model should have a hollow capsule shape with a flat bottom, adjustable inner diameter, length, wall thickness, and a specific leg opening diameter, featuring distributed transverse air vents along its body.
captions.factory: The design is built using a low-resolution sphere and cylinder ($fn=9) to create a faceted capsule shape. This outer shell is unioned, then hollowed out with a smaller concentric cylinder and two spheres. Transverse air holes are subtracted using a for-loop that translates and rotates elongated cubes. Finally, a large cube is subtracted from the bottom to split the capsule in half, and a cylinder is subtracted at one end to form the leg opening.
